title: ClassTurn Studio 10.0 — Universal 2,123-Simulator Production QA Master Questionnaire
description: Consolidated AI & Tester Verification Questionnaire for validating any picked experiment built on the Locked ClassTurn Legacy Layout across all 2,123 simulators.

global_rules.locked_layout_immutability: The 8-section ClassTurn Legacy Layout, CSS tokens (#10564b, #edf6f2, #090d16), 64px header, and Style 2 curvy leader lines are strictly locked.
global_rules.canvas_mouse_interaction: 100% disabled. Clicking, dragging, or scrolling directly on #simCanvas must do nothing.
global_rules.mathml_rule: Every mathematical equation, symbol, subscript, superscript, Greek letter, and unit across all sections must use native horizontal MathML (<math display='block'> or <math display='inline'>) or clean Unicode. Zero raw LaTeX ($, \frac, \sqrt, \Omega, _, ^) is permitted anywhere.

part_1_layout_based_questions.pedagogical_length: 4 to 10 words (<Discipline / Lab Name> — <Standard or Sub-domain>)
part_1_layout_based_questions.mathml_check: Zero raw LaTeX or broken HTML entities (&amp;) in eyebrow text.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does #headerEyebrow accurately state the specific discipline, lab name, and standard/sub-domain of the picked experiment within 4 to 10 words?

part_1_layout_based_questions.mathml_check: Zero raw LaTeX, placeholder text, or character encoding artifacts.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does #headerTitle display the exact, canonical title of the picked experiment in 3 to 8 words without truncation or overflow?

part_1_layout_based_questions.pedagogical_length: Exact status string: 'Science verified' or 'Science not verified'
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Has the science of this simulator (governing laws, equations, units, and physical behavior) been verified? Does #reviewBadge display ONLY 'Science verified' (if verified) or 'Science not verified' (if not yet checked), and NEVER 'Science not reviewed'?

part_1_layout_based_questions.pedagogical_length: Exact status string: '✓ Benchmarked (±0.5%)' / 'Benchmarked' or 'Not benchmarked'
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Are the simulator's numerical outputs, constants, and parameter ranges benchmarked against authoritative textbook, standard code (NIST/IS/BS/IEEE), or verified internet reference values? Does #benchmarkBadge display ONLY '✓ Benchmarked (±0.5%)' (if benchmarked) or 'Not benchmarked' (if not), and NEVER '✓ MathML preview'?

part_1_layout_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: Must ONLY open/close the feedback modal without pausing, resetting, or altering any simulation state.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does clicking 'Report a problem' (#btnReportProblem) ONLY open #feedbackDialog, and does 'Cancel' (#btnCancelFeedback) ONLY close it, without disturbing the running simulation or controls?

part_1_layout_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: Must ONLY pause/resume simulation time progression without resetting inputs, clearing particles, or changing experiment stage.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does clicking Pause (#btnToggle) freeze ONLY the canvas animation and change button text to 'Run', and does clicking 'Run' resume smoothly from the exact paused frame without a time jump or state reset?

part_1_layout_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: Must ONLY advance simulation by 1 discrete time-step or 1 sequential procedure stage and highlight the active step in 04 / Procedure.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does clicking Step (#btnStep) advance the picked experiment by exactly one discrete frame (for continuous sims) or one sequential stage (for multi-stage sims) and highlight the matching step in #procedureList, without corrupting user-entered input values?

part_1_layout_based_questions.pedagogical_length: 2 or more options, 5 to 12 words each ('Primary Experiment: ...', 'Extended Activity: ...')
part_1_layout_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: Must ONLY switch experiment mode/preset for the selected activity without breaking event listeners.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does the 'Choose experiment' dropdown (#experimentSelect) list meaningful Primary and Extended activities for this topic, and does switching options cleanly update the experiment configuration?

part_1_layout_based_questions.mathml_check: All physical symbols or units in #aimText must use <math display='inline'> with zero raw LaTeX.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does 01 / Aim (#aimText) clearly state what physical quantity or phenomenon is being investigated, using what apparatus/method, in 1 to 2 sentences (20–45 words) with valid inline MathML?

part_1_layout_based_questions.pedagogical_length: 4 to 8 apparatus items; each item 15 to 30 words (<Name> (<Specification/Range/Accuracy>) — <Role>)
part_1_layout_based_questions.mathml_check: All tolerances (±), Greek symbols (Ω, μm, °C), and subscripts in #apparatusList and #apparatusLegendBanner must use <math display='inline'> or clean Unicode.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does 02 / Apparatus list all 4 to 8 real instruments needed for the experiment (15–30 words each with lab specs and role), and do the numbered pills (1..N) in #apparatusLegendBanner match #apparatusList 1-to-1 in count, order, and name?

part_1_layout_based_questions.pedagogical_length: Overview: 1 to 2 paragraphs (60 to 140 words). Equations: 2 to 4 core equations, each with a 3–8 word title, 10–22 word description, display equation, and 'Where:' symbol definitions (5–12 words + unit per symbol).
part_1_layout_based_questions.mathml_check: 100% of display equations must use horizontal <math display='block'> and all 'Where:' symbols/units must use <math display='inline'>. Zero raw LaTeX (\frac, \sqrt, \cdot, \text, _, ^).
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does 03 / Principles provide a 60–140 word theoretical overview and 2–4 accurate governing equations in horizontal MathML with complete 'Where:' symbol/unit definitions that match the exact formulas coded in canvas_js?

part_1_layout_based_questions.pedagogical_length: Overview: 1 to 2 sentences (25 to 50 words). Steps: 5 to 10 numbered chronological steps, 12 to 28 words each.
part_1_layout_based_questions.mathml_check: All variables, symbols, and formulas inside #procedureList must use <math display='inline'>.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does 04 / Procedure present 5 to 10 realistic chronological lab steps (12–28 words each), and can the user actually perform EVERY step using the buttons and input boxes provided in 05 / Controls?

part_1_layout_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: Clicking Preset P_j must ONLY load P_j's parameter values into .stepper-input boxes and update the simulation, without clearing #observationTbody or triggering destructive actions.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: If preset chips (.preset-chip) are present, does clicking each preset load ONLY its intended parameter values into the control inputs and update the canvas/readouts cleanly?

part_1_layout_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: Each .atlas-action-btn B_i must perform ONLY the specific physical action described on its label, never triggering another button's stage or overwriting unrelated independent inputs.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: For EVERY action button (.atlas-action-btn) in 05 / Controls: is its HTML ID wired so clicking it performs ONLY its exact allotted action on the simulation (and no other unintended action), and does it handle repeated clicks cleanly?

part_1_layout_based_questions.category: 05 / Controls — Stepper Input Boxes & Up/Down Arrows
part_1_layout_based_questions.mathml_check: All stepper label symbols (<math>), range hints [min – max unit], and .stepper-unit boxes must use clean MathML/Unicode with zero raw LaTeX.
part_1_layout_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: Changing input box I_k (via typing, ▲/▼ buttons, or keyboard arrows) must modify ONLY parameter I_k and its mathematically coupled/dependent outputs, never mutating unrelated independent inputs or firing unrelated button actions.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: For EVERY control input box (.stepper-input) and its ▲/▼ buttons: does it enforce [min, max, step], and does changing its value update ONLY its intended physical parameter in the simulation and live readings?

part_1_layout_based_questions.pedagogical_length: 3 to 5 live readout items (.readout-item), each with <Heading> (<Symbol>) and <Numeric Value> <Unit>.
part_1_layout_based_questions.mathml_check: All symbols in .readout-heading and units in .readout-val must render in clean MathML/Unicode with zero duplicate units (e.g. 'kg kg') and zero NaN/Infinity.
part_1_layout_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: Each readout R_m must change IF AND ONLY IF a control variable in its governing equation changes.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Do all 3 to 5 live readings in 06 / Live readings calculate accurate benchmarked values from 03 / Principles equations, formatted to clean decimal precision with proper units?

part_1_layout_based_questions.pedagogical_length: 4 to 7 bullet items (2–4 'Assumption:' items and 2–3 'Boundary Limit:' items), 12 to 25 words each.
part_1_layout_based_questions.mathml_check: All inequalities, bounds, and symbols in #validationList must use <math display='inline'> with zero raw LaTeX.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does 07 / Validation and limits list 2–4 real physical assumptions and 2–3 boundary limits specific to this experiment (12–25 words each) with clean inline MathML?

part_1_layout_based_questions.mathml_check: All column headers in #observationThead must use <math display='inline'> for symbols/units, and recorded <td> cells must contain zero raw LaTeX.
part_1_layout_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: #btnRecord must ONLY append 1 row matching the exact columns of #observationThead. #btnReset must restore all inputs, readouts, and canvas state to defaults and clear #observationTbody.
part_1_layout_based_questions.question: Does clicking 'Record Observation' (#btnRecord) append exactly 1 row to #observationTbody where every <td> cell matches its <th> column header and unit, and does 'Reset to Defaults' (#btnReset) restore all controls, readouts, canvas stage, and clear the table?

part_2_canvas_based_questions.question: Does the canvas draw the authentic physical laboratory apparatus of the picked experiment (across Mechanics, Circuits, Optics, Chemistry, Fluids, Civil, Biology, or CS) in its true spatial/coaxial arrangement rather than generic placeholder shapes?

Is 100% of the apparatus setup—including side meters, top frames, bottom benches, waveforms, and moving parts at their extreme positions—fitted inside the 800×500 stage with at least 12px margin on all 4 edges (zero clipping/truncation)?

Does the bounding-box fit (Math.min(scaleW, scaleH) with aspect ratio compensation) maintain true 1:1 square pixel proportions so circular dials, lenses, pendulums, and badges are never stretched horizontally or vertically?
Is direct user mouse interaction (clicking, double-clicking, dragging, hovering, wheel-scrolling) on #simCanvas 100% disabled so the simulation can ONLY be operated via the right-hand control panel?

part_2_canvas_based_questions.category: Numbered Badges & Style 2 Curvy Leader Lines
part_2_canvas_based_questions.question: Are all N numbered badges (1..N matching #apparatusLegendBanner) drawn on top of the apparatus (Layer 3), each connected by a green cubic Bezier S-curve (#34d399) and anchor touch bead landing directly on the correct physical apparatus part?
Are all badges separated by at least 36–40px with zero overlap against other badges or meter text, and do leader-line touch beads dynamically track apparatus parts that move or rotate?

part_2_canvas_based_questions.category: Canvas Text Legibility & Zero Raw LaTeX
part_2_canvas_based_questions.question: Is all text rendered inside the canvas (digital LED readouts, scale ticks, node labels) legible (>= 9px), high-contrast, properly fitted inside its meter box without overflowing, and 100% free of raw LaTeX?

part_2_canvas_based_questions.category: Canvas Visual Cause-and-Effect — Per Input Box Isolation
part_2_canvas_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: Changing input box I_k must visually update ONLY the physical feature governed by I_k on the canvas.
part_2_canvas_based_questions.question: When each control input box (.stepper-input) is modified, does the canvas visually reflect ONLY that parameter's physical effect (e.g., fluid/concrete fill level, ray angle, fringe spacing, wave frequency, beam deflection, meter needle, or packet speed) without disturbing unrelated apparatus parts?

part_2_canvas_based_questions.category: Canvas Visual Cause-and-Effect — Per Action Button Isolation
part_2_canvas_based_questions.intended_action_isolation: Clicking action button B_i must animate ONLY B_i's specific physical mechanism on the canvas.
part_2_canvas_based_questions.question: When each custom action button (.atlas-action-btn) is clicked, does the canvas animate ONLY that button's intended physical mechanism (e.g., opening a specific trap door, closing a switch, adding a drop, or tamping) and nothing else?

Does every digital display, weighing scale LED, voltmeter/ammeter needle, thermometer, or oscilloscope readout drawn inside #simCanvas show the exact same numerical value and unit as 06 / Live readings?

part_3_production_readiness_and_stabilit.question: If a user types an out-of-range value (below min, above max), 0, negative number, or empty string into any .stepper-input box, does the simulator clamp/guard it safely without producing NaN, Infinity, undefined, or division-by-zero on the canvas or readouts?
Are all numbers in input boxes, live readings, canvas meters, and recorded observation rows cleanly rounded to appropriate decimal precision (zero floating-point noise like 15.600000000000001)?
Does every physical variable use the exact same symbol and compatible unit across 03 / Principles, 05 / Controls, 06 / Live readings, Observation notebook columns, and on-canvas meters?
When dragging #resizerGutter left/right or resizing the browser window, does #controlsPanel resize smoothly and does #simCanvas dynamically re-fit and re-center without clipping or distortion?
When clicking Reset, Pause/Run, Step, Presets, or Choose experiment repeatedly, does the simulator maintain a single 60 FPS requestAnimationFrame loop without spawning duplicate stacked loops?
Does the HTML file load and execute all interactions with zero JavaScript console errors and zero external internet/CDN requests?

part_3_production_readiness_and_stabilit.category: Locked Legacy Layout & Database Reconstruction Parity
part_3_production_readiness_and_stabilit.question: Is the Locked ClassTurn Legacy Layout 100% unaltered, and can this complete simulator be reconstructed solely from classturn_simulators.db + universal_simulator.html with 100% identical content and behavior?
